Rome, 1880. Gregorio has decided to close the family business. Then he tells his children that they will have to fend for themselves, but his beautiful, calculating, ambitious young daughter-in-law, will do anything for the inheritance.

As a megaquake threatens San Francisco, a series of foreshocks wreaks havoc across the city. Now an elite team of emergency service and disaster experts converge on the anticipated epicentre, working tirelessly to save as many lives as possible before the city is crushed into oblivion.

Across Singapore's heartlands, a quiet movement is gaining momentum—ordinary residents transforming their HDB flats into hubs of enterprise. HUSTLE IN MY HDB explores the growing number of Singaporeans turning their HDB flats into full-fledged businesses, offering everything from gourmet private dining to artisanal coffee, hair styling, and beauty treatments. Who are the people behind these ventures? What drives them to turn their personal spaces into places of commerce? And how do they navigate the grey areas between regulation, family expectations, and entrepreneurial ambition?

Lingo is the fast paced word-play game that keeps on innovating for new audiences, with its mix of skill, tension, humour and the chance to win big cash prizes. Teams are pitted against each other in a battle to fill in the blanks and find words.

Master builder and household favourite Tommy Walsh is joined by expert pro cleaner Maxine Dwyer and creative carpenter Asher Edwards, as they meet people across the UK who are struggling with household chaos, grime and clutter. Much more than a makeover show, our dynamic professionals provide real-life, practical solutions, invaluable tips and insider tricks to give viewers brilliant take-away ideas for bettering their own living spaces.

Hiccup and Sneeze notice that Bibi is acting and talking funny. Multi-coloured spots are also slowly appearing all over her body. Eventually, they discover from Ellard that Bibi has Monsteritis! Luckily for her, Ellard knows the cure.

Anything and everything can happen IN OUR HOUSE. A magical and colorful house with equally quirky occupants. ALVIN loves to read and always has the answers to any problems. SEAN, the resident joker, is affable with his misadventures. The rose among the thorns, K-NA proves herself a strong independent lady who does not need to wait for a knight in shining armour. Together, they are joined by MEX and BO, the two monsters who love to have fun. Innovative segments with a deep focus and awareness are all part of the entertaining and engaging new format. IN OUR HOUSE is full of surprises and is more interactive and energetic than you have ever seen before. In an entertaining mix of song, dance, music and drama, join the wacky hosts as they introduce the LETTERS AND NUMBERS OF THE DAY and the adventures that they encounter. Follow them through the SHOCKADELIC DOOR, which will lead them to interesting and unexpected places. Look out through the WINDOW to learn and see more things than you could ever imagine. And the MAGIC BOX brings to you unexpected gifts that can only be culled by your imagination. IN OUR HOUSE opens its doors to a host of characters from the fairy tales and nursery rhymes. Learn more about these characters and you would be surprised with the new and unexpected twists that the characters reveal in the show. The BIG BAD WOLF is simply a misunderstood wolf. GOLDILOCKS visits with a bowl of porridge but got distracted by the hosts' red cherries and strawberries. LITTLE BO BEEP was lost looking for her sheep that ran away but ended up IN OUR HOUSE. And the PRINCESS WITH THE PEA is on the search for her missing pre-nuptial gifts. These and many other colourful characters will pay a visit IN OUR HOUSE for some fun and game.

Can you spell words like necessary, accommodate or even Kyrgyzstan without the help of Spell Check? Well, our Spell Casters can! This season on Spell Cast, 48 kids aged 9-11 from 30 schools around Singapore are here for the ultimate spelling challenge! They are some of the best spellers around and nothing fazes them. One of them will be crowned the Spell Cast champion at the end of 13 weeks. Who will it be?

Kristiansen took on the role of a chef in Einstein’s Tingkat, a cooking and arts show where he and a group of children, playing chefs too, would draw the dishes they wanted to cook before bringing the recipes to life.
The adventures of Tayo, a blue bus with the number 120. He is very playful and mischievous with his passengers and his friends.

A petty official in the Tang Dynasty is given the impossible task of delivering fresh lychee from Lingnan to Imperial Consort Yang's birthday banquet in Chang'an, a distance of over 2500 kilometers. He has three months to make the impossible possible. The penalty for failure is death for him and slavery for his family.

Xiao Wu Xia, the young lord of Yueluo City, has been living in hiding in Liang Kingdom under the alias Wei Zhao, bearing the shame of being labeled a traitor. His mission is to uncover the truth behind his family’s downfall and capture the sole survivor of Prince Qi’s case. However, his plans are derailed by the unexpected arrival of Jiang Ci. Pei Yan takes the injured Jiang Ci into his home, aiming to discover who’s behind the disruption.

Xu Wei Hao was born with a silver spoon. After the decline of his family wealth, he remains unambitious, even his daughter looks down on him. Wei Hao's neighbor, Li Zheng Yi, is a cowardly cop. He is in a relationship with Liu Xue Hua, a single mother and they live together. Her children refuse to accept him as their stepfather. Xue Hua refuse to forgive her ex-husband, Chen Kai, who has just been released from prison. The three men accidentally ate mysterious chocolates ... 许伟豪出身富裕的伟豪，在家道中落后依旧缺乏进取心，连女儿也看不起他。住在伟豪同层楼的邻居李正义是个胆小怕事的警察，他与单亲妈妈刘雪华交往并同住在一屋檐下，可是雪华的儿女却拒绝接受这个小男人当后父。雪华无法原谅刚出狱的前夫陈凯，还告诉他孩子们也不会认这个作奸犯科的爸爸。三个男人人无意中吃了神秘巧克力…

Modern women with new-age beliefs. Is marriage really hell or bliss? Papa Hao is a widowed restaurant chef who single-handedly raised three daughters. Eldest daughter Meiman is a successful advertising agent who believes that women should always place career before marriage. Ironic to her extravagant lifestyle, Meiman ends up with her miserly colleague whom she bickers with incessantly from workplace to home.. Second daughter Meili is a TV producer who yearns to start a family but is always rejected by her matchmaking prospects because of her ordinary looks. When she finally chances upon her Korean Prince Charming, she finds that her younger sister too has fallen for the same guy...Youngest daughter Meide is an independent and open-minded graduate who has been spoilt by her father and sisters. While she enjoys the pursuit by her suitors, she does not equate love to marriage. Not until she meets her traditional mother-in-law-to-be and sparks start flying... Like all romantic fairy tales, will the three sisters get married and live happily ever after?

An international cast from Singapore, China, Taiwan and Korea display their acting chops in this colourful drama of mythical legends and deities. Stars Cao Jun (from China) as Chen Xiang, Jiao En-Jun (Taiwan) as Erlang Deity, Liu Xiao Qing (China) as Wangmu Niangniang, Yvonne Lim (Singapore) as Ding Xiang and Park Mi-sun (Korean) as Sanshengmu

This drama is set in the Jiufen area from the 1960s to the 1970s. It tells the story of how three brothers conquered the world with their bare hands. Through the love story of the previous generation, it connects the common emotions between the two generations depicting the memories and in-depth exploration of the differences in values between them. 本剧以1960年代至1970年代的九份地区为背景，述说三个拜把兄弟如何赤手空拳打天下，藉由上一代的爱情故事串连与第二代之间共同的情感与记忆，深度探索两代之间的价值观差异。

TV star Nina Sokil is diagnosed with bone cancer, but deeming her career to be more important with her health, Nina goes to absurd lengths to hide her condition so that she keeps working.

Ukrainian immigrant Irina lives with her son Igor in a small Czech border town. When she discovers that Igor has been assaulted by three Romas her whole world comes crashing down. As times goes on, Irina begins to spot inconsistencies in his story.

p.t: Once Upon A Time In Calcutta
p.d: Having just lost her daughter and disillusioned with her marriage, Ela decides to start an independent life of her own. Unable to secure a housing loan, she uses her boss, the owner of a ponzi scheme, to get what she wants.

Vera, a devoted wife, mother, and grandmother, has her serene life turned upside down by her husband's sudden suicide. As greedy relatives and an underworld scheme threaten their family’s home, she must confront danger and take control of her own fate.

A young, vulnerable couple inherits a cork-harvesting farm in rural Catalonia. As newly fledged landowners, they dream of building a fair and sustainable life, only to find their ideals clash head-on with their dire need to make money.

How far would you go to repay a life debt? When a loyal family man Mathieu falls for his best friend's mistress, a simple cover-up spirals into a dangerous game of desire, deception and betrayal where every choice comes at a price.

In an age where loneliness is common and connection feels like currency, a new kind of companion has arrived on the market: the AI chatbot. Always awake, always responsive, always affirming. But how much of a real friend or companion can something digital ever be? Our series follows four individuals here in Singapore – different in age, culture, circumstance, yet united by a willingness to explore something different. Over the course of two weeks, each participant shapes their own “ideal” AI companion and introduces it into their life. We witness the ups and downs of these encounters, examining and analysing emotional motivations and algorithmic responses with experts ranging from relationship coaches to AI developers. In the end, the question is: Can AI really fill that human space where a friend or a companion should be?
From business to politics, health to technology, the latest news from Singapore and analysis of the impact.

Twice a year, Asia’s coastlines enter a brief, rare window of extraordinary equinox “king tides” where the Sun, Moon and Earth align and the sea surges beyond its usual limits. In that short period, homes, sea walls, livelihoods and ecosystems are stress-tested and the shoreline becomes a moving border. Tides of Time is a three-part series narrated by BAFTA-nominated presenter and Sunday Times best-selling author Ben Fogle. Filmed in Bangladesh, China and South Korea, the team chases this celestial trigger along three epic shores where water doesn’t just rise but rewrites the communities’ destinies. From Sundarbans’ Hanging Homes Village, to China’s Qiantang “Silver Dragon” tidal bore, to Korea’s getbol mudflats, each film is a human rendezvous with the tide where humans must choose to adapt, resist or surrender.
News and views from around the region, delivered with uniquely Asian perspectives.

What does it take for everyday hawker stalls to earn Michelin recognition, and can they keep their Bib Gourmand status? How has the accolade impacted the life of these humble hawkers? At Bahrakath Mutton Soup, sole chef Syed Abdul Rahaman grapples with passing down this award-winning taste to his sons as age creeps up on him. Over at Selamat Datang Warong Pak Sapari, second-generation owner Sumadi Sapari walks the tightrope between expanding the business and protecting the authenticity of his late father's recipe. For Koh Brother Pig Organ Soup, Thomas Koh left his career to carry on a family legacy. After failed franchising attempts, he's poured himself into making every bowl the best it can be. And at Chef Kang's Noodle House, brothers Benson and Winson Moo—disciples of Michelin-starred Chef Kang—have won, lost, and regained their Bib Gourmand. This year, the question looms: can they hold onto it?
Non-stop breaking stories, expert analysis and extensive news coverage every hour.

Salt is one of humanity's oldest creations, an invisible force that has shaped trade, rituals and civilisation itself. This documentary series journeys across the Philippines and Japan archipelagos to uncover rare and vasnishing salt-making traditions where land, sea, fire and time converge. Each episode follows a salt artisan whose craft holds patience, intuition and deep local knowledge; from earthenware salt that is forged by fire, to seaweed-infused minerals once offered to emperors. Continued by makers who stand as quiet acts of resistance, each story explores how taste becomes history, how labour becomes sacred ritual, and how something as small as a grain of salt can carry the weight of place, culture and ancestral memory.

A drama series about the students of SMK Ayer Dalam, who lives are turned upside down when they learn that their school is at risk of being demolished. Putting aside their differences, Alya, Asma, Boi and their friends join forces with thier discipline teacher, Cikgu Azza, to save their beloved school. Along the way, they discover the true meaning of friendship, teamwork and standing up for what matters most.

A tight knit quirky family of three makes a great recipe for an excellent meal and a good laugh. Lesung is a cooking show that blends traditional and modern food demonstration with a light hearted family drama. Lesung adalah drama info yang memaparkan pertunjukan masakan makanan tradisional dan moden. Ia menceritakan tentang kisah sebuah kelauarga dan bagaimana masakan dan makanan boleh eratkan lagi hubungan mereka.

In order to win Rosemaria's heart and heirloom, Dylea hunts for the lost grandchild and finds him in the hands of Zaheem. Can Dylea convinces Zaheem to hand over the child with her evil aunty Anita breathing down her neck?

SGD10000 is the latest gameshow series to hit television screens! Every week, host Khairusin Samsudin will challenge teams comprising of two members on facts and landmarks across Singapore. The pair of contestants will have to answer 10 questions along chosen routes across Singapore to retain their money. Contrary to usual concepts, the contestants start out with their full prize money ($10,000) and will have money deducted for every wrong answer. Catch the weekly exhilarating episodes! SGD10000 Win or Lose, the show must go on!

Shahrul gets upset when he finds out that Riyan is on the same business trip with Humairah in Jakarta. They have an argument and Humairah's father overhears the argument and gets upset with Shahrul. A man's refusal to reveal that his daughter is adopted, inadvertently jeopardizes the solemnization.

22 teams from Institutes of Higher Learning come together to compete for the prestigious title of Piala Suara Serumpun 2025 Champion. The competition showcases an exhilirating fusion of poetic lyrics, melodious choral singing, artistic movement and dynamic music. Hosted by Fadli Kamsani and Lydia Asyiqin with special performance by Rahila Rashun and Nobat Kota Singa. Bertemakan “Antara Wajah dan Pemikiran Masyarakat”, 22 kumpulan pelajar beradu minda, bertingkah kata, bergema suara, mengatur gerak dan mengalun nada untuk merebut gelaran juara Piala Suara Serumpun 2025. Rancangan ini dihoskan oleh Fadli Kamsani dan Lydia Asyiqin dengan persembahan khas oleh Rahila Rashun dan Nobat Kota Singa.

In Air Tangan, family bonds are rekindled as generations come together to rediscover cherished family recipes. Watch a Gen Z influencer embark on a culinary adventure with their elder relative, who teaches them the art of traditional Malay cooking while the younger generation introduces modern and fusion dishes. As they cook together, they share personal stories, reminisce childhood memories, and delve into the cultural significance of each dish. Dalam siri Air Tangan, dua generasi berbeza bersatu dan mengukuhkan ikatan keluarga serta memasak resipi keluarga turun temurun. Saksikan pempengaruh Gen Z belajar memasak daripada warga emas dalam keluarga mereka. Pempengaruh itu akan memperkenalkan hidangan moden dan fusion kepada nenek atau Ibu saudara mereka. Sambil memasak bersama, mereka berkongsi kisah peribadi, mengimbas kenangan silam dan menyelami resipi dan asal usul setiap hidangan.

Building on the creative spirit of Berani Nyanyi, comes Berani Lakon, an unconventional acting competition where familiar faces step out of their comfort zones to showcase talents you never knew they had. Hosted by the charismatic trio Hafidz Rahman, Era Farida, and Endang Rahayu, this series promises laughter, drama, and plenty of surprises. With its bold concept and infectious energy, Berani Lakon is set to captivate local audiences for 9 exciting weeks. Dari konsep kreatif Berani Nyanyi, hadirnya Berani Lakon, pertandingan lakonan luarbiasa di mana para penonton bakal teruja menyaksikan sisi baharu peserta-peserta yang tidak disangka mempunyai bakat berlakon di atas pentas. Dihoskan oleh trio penuh karisma Hafidz Rahman, Era Farida, dan Endang Rahayu, siri ini sarat dengan aksi, emosi dan kejutan yang mencuit hati. Dengan konsep segar dan menghiburkan, Berani Lakon pasti menawan hati penonton tempatan selama 9 minggu.
